comments: cef1b57b: This section of the code is responsible for generating a report of delinquent records, categorized by division.
272e8f5e: Print the division name and its corresponding total number of delinquent records.
76d143f6: End of the program.
1bab6aff: Header for the totals page, displaying column titles for divisions and their total delinquencies.
465cd7cd: Fill the remainder of the page with blank lines up to the designated footer area.
8a3b9e11: Retrieve and display the total delinquent records for the specified division.
53d25a43: Exit the subroutine if the output is not being displayed on a terminal.
cc32eea3: Prompt the user to continue with the report or to quit.
d9db2bd8: Reset page numbering when the division changes.
30874f87: Print the report header, including the report type and the sorting criterion.
5bdde1f2: Column headers for reports sorted by event date.
68815e51: Column headers for reports not sorted by event date.
4ce22aa6: Print standard column headers for all reports.
133eeb99: Column headers for reports not sorted by physician, including a status column if the report type is 'incomplete'.
8c23a080: Column headers for reports sorted by physician, including a status column if the report type is 'incomplete'.
fcbad9ca: End of the subroutine.
87a9399b: Clean up by killing local and global variables used in the report.
a4464200: Further cleanup, including killing additional variables and closing the device if opened.
3018ce56: Kill variables related to the RT package.
560a45d4: Close the device used for the report.
bb463018: Print the total count of undictated or incomplete records for a physician and pause if not on a terminal.
21a51925: Print the total count of undictated or incomplete records for a service point.
c45cbcd8: Print the subtotal count of undictated or incomplete records for a service and pause if not on a terminal.
365ada6b: End of the subroutine.
47b5f6c5: Print the abbreviated name of the disposition type.
428facb2: Print the status of the record if the report is of type 'incomplete'.
25e247ab: Print the total number of days the record has been delinquent.
3426d723: End of the subroutine.
